result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the promotional banner's text has insufficient contrast and appears washed out, making the offer difficult to read.

issues.description: The promo banner text is nearly invisible, with the white heading and subtext having very low contrast against the pale mint-green background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the promotional text or use a darker banner background so the heading, code, and minimum-order details are clearly legible.
